# Skills catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/catalog.py from each skill's front matter. Do not edit by hand: change the SKILL.md, then run `python3 scripts/catalog.py`. -->

This is the **skills marketplace** of pm-agents: every skill the team can use, who owns it and how far you can trust it. Every skill is *brain-aware*: it reads your `brain/brain.yaml` and your `brain/preferences/`, so it works on your product without changes ([docs/SKILL-STANDARD.md](docs/SKILL-STANDARD.md)).

- **Use a skill:** in Devin CLI type `/<name>` (for example `/weekly-status`), or just ask in plain words and the right skill is picked.
- **Add or improve one:** see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **Status:** `stable` = tested and used for real; `experimental` = new or not yet tested in real use, check its output; `deprecated` = being replaced.
- **Brain:** `required` = needs your brain (run `/onboard` first); `optional` = works without it; `none` = never touches it.

11 skills.

## Skills

### ask

`/ask` · Brain Keeper · brain · stable · v0.2.0 · owner: pm-agents core

Answer questions about the PM's product, people, decisions, meetings and plans using only what is in the second brain, with citations; for team questions, also search the team hub. Use when the user types /ask, or asks "what did we decide about…", "who owns…", "when did…", "what do we know about…", "what did we believe in August…", "remind me…", "what is the team doing on…". Read-only.

- **Brain:** required
- **Reads:** `brain/`, `<team_hub.path>/digests/`, `<team_hub.path>/products/`, `jira`, `confluence`
- **Writes:** nothing (read-only)
- **Honours preferences:** —
- **Requires:** `python3`, `team-hub`, `jira-mcp`, `confluence-mcp`
- **Source:** [.agents/skills/ask/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/ask/SKILL.md)

### decision

`/decision` · Brain Keeper · brain · experimental · v0.2.0 · owner: pm-agents core

Log a product decision straight from the chat in one step, check whether it replaces an older decision, and offer to mark the old one as superseded. Use when the user types /decision, or says "log a decision", "we decided…", "record that we chose…", "Ana decided today that…", "note this decision".

- **Brain:** required
- **Reads:** `brain/brain.yaml`, `brain/preferences/`, `brain/products/<slug>/decisions/`, `brain/products/<slug>/topics/`, `brain/products/<slug>/index.md`
- **Writes:** `brain/products/<slug>/decisions/`, `brain/products/<slug>/topics/`, `brain/products/<slug>/index.md`
- **Honours preferences:** `decision.md`
- **Requires:** `python3`, `git`
- **Source:** [.agents/skills/decision/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/decision/SKILL.md)

### ingest

`/ingest` · Brain Keeper · brain · stable · v0.2.0 · owner: pm-agents core

Process meeting transcripts and notes into the second brain, all inbox files in one batch with a single approval at the end. Use when the user types /ingest, drops files into brain/inbox/ (.vtt, .docx, .txt, .md), pastes meeting notes or a transcript, or says "process my meeting", "file this transcript", "add these notes to the brain".

- **Reads:** `brain/brain.yaml`, `brain/preferences/`, `brain/inbox/`, `brain/stakeholders/`, `brain/products/<slug>/product/`, `brain/products/<slug>/decisions/`, `brain/products/<slug>/topics/`, `brain/products/<slug>/index.md`
- **Writes:** `brain/products/<slug>/meetings/`, `brain/stakeholders/`, `brain/products/<slug>/topics/`, `brain/products/<slug>/index.md`, `brain/inbox/processed/`, `brain/products/<slug>/decisions/`, `brain/products/<slug>/product/`, `brain/products/<slug>/roadmap/`, `brain/products/<slug>/hypotheses/`
- **Honours preferences:** `README.md`, `meeting-note.md`
- **Requires:** `python3`, `git`
- **Source:** [.agents/skills/ingest/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/ingest/SKILL.md)

### onboard

`/onboard` · Brain Keeper · brain · stable · v0.2.0 · owner: pm-agents core

Set up the PM's second brain (the brain/ folder) for the first time, add another product to an existing brain, or connect the brain to the team hub later. Use when the user types /onboard, says "set me up", "get started", "add a product", "connect me to the team hub", or when any other skill finds that brain/brain.yaml does not exist.

- **Brain:** optional
- **Reads:** `brain/brain.yaml`, `templates/brain/`, `templates/stakeholder.md`, `templates/persona.md`, `templates/product-index.md`, `templates/team-hub/member.md`, `<team_hub.path>/members/`
- **Writes:** `brain/ (skeleton)`, `brain/brain.yaml`, `brain/preferences/persona.md`, `brain/stakeholders/`, `brain/products/<slug>/product/overview.md`, `brain/products/<slug>/index.md`, `<team_hub.path>/members/<person-slug>.md`
- **Honours preferences:** `persona.md`
- **Requires:** `team-hub`, `git`
- **Source:** [.agents/skills/onboard/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/onboard/SKILL.md)

### sweep

`/sweep` · Brain Keeper · brain · experimental · v0.2.0 · owner: pm-agents core

Weekly "dreaming" pass that tidies the second brain - merges duplicate notes, marks contradicted decisions as superseded, flags stale notes, promotes repeated observations to product pages, rebuilds topic hubs and the product index, and writes a sweep report. Use when the user types /sweep, says "tidy my brain", "clean up the brain", "weekly upkeep", or on Fridays before /publish.

- **Brain:** required
- **Reads:** `brain/brain.yaml`, `brain/products/<slug>/`, `brain/stakeholders/`, `brain/products/<slug>/sweeps/`
- **Writes:** `brain/products/<slug>/meetings/`, `brain/products/<slug>/decisions/`, `brain/products/<slug>/product/`, `brain/products/<slug>/topics/`, `brain/products/<slug>/index.md`, `brain/products/<slug>/sweeps/`
- **Honours preferences:** —
- **Requires:** `python3`, `git`
- **Source:** [.agents/skills/sweep/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/sweep/SKILL.md)

### connect-dots

`/connect-dots` · Connector · team · experimental · v0.2.0 · owner: pm-agents core

Look across the team hub's recent digests and product cards to find where PMs could work together - overlaps (two people building the same thing), reuse (one person's reusable asset matches another's need), combinations (two pieces that together enable something new) and dependencies or risks between teams - each with evidence, confidence and a next step. Use when the user types /connect-dots, or says "connect the dots", "find overlaps", "who could reuse what", "what could we build together", "are two people doing the same thing". Primary user is the manager; any PM can run it. Reads only the hub.

- **Brain:** required
- **Reads:** `brain/brain.yaml`, `<team_hub.path>/digests/`, `<team_hub.path>/products/`, `<team_hub.path>/members/`, `<team_hub.path>/connections/`
- **Writes:** `brain/products/<slug>/research/ (after yes)`, `<team_hub.path>/connections/ (after yes)`
- **Honours preferences:** —
- **Requires:** `python3`, `team-hub`, `git`
- **Source:** [.agents/skills/connect-dots/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/connect-dots/SKILL.md)

### publish

`/publish` · Reporter · team · experimental · v0.2.0 · owner: pm-agents core

Write the PM's weekly digest and product card update from the second brain, run the privacy check, show the exact text, and after an explicit yes commit and push it to the shared team hub (pm-team-hub). Use when the user types /publish, or says "publish my week", "send my digest to the team hub", "update my product card", "share this week with the team". Usually run on Friday after /sweep.

- **Brain:** required
- **Reads:** `brain/brain.yaml`, `brain/preferences/`, `brain/products/<slug>/`, `<team_hub.path>/digests/`, `<team_hub.path>/products/`, `<team_hub.path>/members/`
- **Writes:** `<team_hub.path>/digests/`, `<team_hub.path>/products/`, `<team_hub.path>/members/`
- **Honours preferences:** `digest.md`, `product-card.md`
- **Requires:** `python3`, `team-hub`, `git`
- **Source:** [.agents/skills/publish/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/publish/SKILL.md)

### team-status

`/team-status` · Reporter · team · experimental · v0.2.0 · owner: pm-agents core

Roll up the team's weekly digests from the shared team hub (pm-team-hub) into one short portfolio view - each person's headline and products, cross-team risks, open asks grouped by who could help, and who hasn't published. Use when the user types /team-status, or says "team status", "portfolio roll-up", "how is the team doing this week", "what did everyone publish", "who hasn't published". Primary user is the manager; any PM can run it. Reads only the hub.

- **Brain:** required
- **Reads:** `brain/brain.yaml`, `<team_hub.path>/digests/`, `<team_hub.path>/members/`, `<team_hub.path>/products/`
- **Writes:** `brain/products/<slug>/status/ (after yes)`
- **Honours preferences:** —
- **Requires:** `python3`, `team-hub`, `git`
- **Source:** [.agents/skills/team-status/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/team-status/SKILL.md)
